archive.description: full backup — complete tool outputs and the raw session, with touched-file lists (heavy)

quick.description: the raw session, losslessly — one native-JSON file per session (fast, compact)

study.description: a readable log plus a searchable corpus, no raw copy (medium)

review.description: the readable log without reasoning, plus the raw session (does not redact)

notes.description: plain read — every message, tool output truncated to ~500 chars (light)

conversation.description: the dialogue only — no tools, patches or reasoning (light)

prompts.description: just your prompts — no answers, reasoning or tools (task log)

rag.description: one line per session — tokens, asks, todos, tools and digests (summary)
